skip_gpu_tests: create a decorator to skip GPU tests on machines without CUDA available
enable_ddp_environment: create a decorator to enable distributed data parallel environment for testing
run_and_compare_models: test two PyTorch models by running inputs through both and comparing outputs
find_modules_in_model: review a PyTorch model to find if it contains modules of a specific type
test_model_equivalence: test model transformation correctness by comparing before and after outputs with tolerance
